meta.promptText: Which brand's kurta sets should I buy for women online in India?

response.text:
If you’re shopping for **women’s kurta sets online in India**, I’d focus on these brands rather than buying random marketplace labels. Recent 2026 comparisons particularly rate **W, Biba, Fabindia, Aurelia and Lakshita** for different combinations of fit, fabric, comfort and styling. [www.hindustantimes.com](https://www.hindustantimes.com/lifestyle/fashion/i-tried-kurta-sets-from-w-fabindia-aurelia-biba-and-lakshita-here-s-which-ones-actually-feel-worth-the-money-101778651587378.html?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

### My brand shortlist

| Brand | Best for | Typical feel |
|---|---|---|
| **W for Woman** | Office + polished everyday wear | Contemporary, structured |
| **Biba** | Everyday + versatile ethnic wear | Reliable, comfortable |
| **Libas** | Best value + trendy styles | Modern, lots of variety |
| **Aurelia** | Dressier/occasion sets | Feminine, polished |
| **Fabindia** | Cotton + understated elegance | Artisanal, timeless |
| **Soch** | Festive + traditional styles | More embellished |
| **Janasya** | Affordable cotton sets | Light, youthful |
| **Lakshita / Nayam by Lakshita** | Comfortable casual wear | Relaxed, easy |


**If I had to narrow it to three:**  
- **W for Woman** → best overall if you want a polished look, especially for work.  
- **Biba** → safest all-rounder for a wardrobe of repeat-wear kurta sets.  
- **Libas** → excellent if you want **more variety at lower prices**; current online selections include many sets around the ₹800–₹1,500 range. [zoutons.com](https://zoutons.com/news/myntra-kurta-sets-under-2000-trending-styles-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

For example, current shopping results include [Libas Women's Floral Embroidered Straight Suit Set]() and [Biba Women's Floral Printed Kurta Set]().

### What I'd buy by occasion

**For office:** W for Woman, Biba, Libas  
**For daily cotton wear:** Biba, Fabindia, Janasya, Lakshita  
**For festivals/functions:** Aurelia, Soch, Biba, W  
**For a more premium/artisanal look:** Fabindia  
**For budget-friendly shopping:** Libas, Janasya, Lakshita

If you tell me your **budget per set (e.g. ₹1,000, ₹2,000 or ₹3,000), age/style preference, and whether you want cotton**, I can narrow it down to the **best 5–10 actual kurta sets currently available online in India**.
